## 修改 / Change

说明问题、改动与原因。Explain the problem, change and reason.

## 来源 / Source

已有 Issue 就链接；独立小修复说明背景即可，不要求先建 Issue。Link an existing task, or explain an independent fix.

## 验证 / Validation

检查方式、结果、仍待确认的部分。Checks, results and remaining review.

## 需要协作 / Support

接收仓库与分支、复核需求、后续动作。Destination repository/branch, review needs and follow-up.
